CustomField.description: The checklist group this item belongs to. MASTER-DETAIL, so access is inherited from the group and in turn from the Transaction, and deleting a checklist removes its items. required and deleteConstraint are deliberately absent - the Metadata API rejects both on a master-detail field, which is always required and always cascades. NON-PERMISSIONABLE: it must never appear in a permission set fieldPermissions block.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The checklist group this item sits in. Set at creation and cannot be changed afterwards.
CustomField.label: Checklist
